name: Cadence & Queue Audit
subtitle: Diagnose your posting rhythm and spot queue gaps and pile-ups.
summary: Compares your scheduled queue against your recent posting history and performance, flags gaps and pile-ups, and proposes queue moves, one card per change.
get: queue gaps and pile-ups, cadence verdict, proposed reschedules as approval cards.
